desc: Derive reduction: for substring ending in nonzero digit d, value = 10Q+d, so d divides it iff m = d/gcd(d,10) divides Q.
Implement online remainder-count DP per modulus m in {1,2,3,4,7,9} with empty suffix included; query cnt_m[0] before updating with current digit, then update all arrays.
Validate the implementation on examples "12936" -> 11, "5701283" -> 18, "1010101010" -> 25, plus edge cases all zeros, single digit, and n=10^5.
